Subject: Renewal kickoff — staircase upgrade + QBR booking

Hi Amina / Blake —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. Per our renewal planning cadence, I wanted to officially kick off the handoff and outline the first 30 days so we can lock the term changes and capacity uplift before contract renewal. High-level asks below and next steps: 

- Goal: move BlueShift from the current committed tier to a 2-stage staircase (Q1 burst + Q3 baseline uplift).
- Key dates: internal renewal due 2026-11-01, target QBR week w/c 2026-10-18 for exec readout.
- Immediate needs from you: confirm preferred QBR week window (see calendar poll), any regulatory docs we need for procurement, and top 3 usage patterns for the uplift (peak hour TPS, average seq length, embeddings volume).

I'll loop in RevOps and CS to scope pricing and onboarding staffing. Attached is a draft mutual action plan to get us moving (short checklist + responsibilities). Please let me know if I should invite other stakeholders on your side (billing contact or security reviewer).

Proposed next steps (happy to adjust):
1) You complete the calendar poll by EOD 9/8 — we book the QBR
2) Marissa will run a short readiness call (teams/30m) the week of 9/13 to size the onboarding runbook
3) Karthik will produce a config snapshot for the uplift (quantization/re-routing recommendations) by 9/20
4) RevOps (David) will issue preliminary term/price options by 9/24

Thanks — want to keep momentum here.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0124

Attachment: BlueShift_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (7 pages — plan + responsibilities)

Mateo —

Thanks for the clear plan. Blake and I reviewed this morning and we're aligned on the staircase approach. Two quick items from our side: 

- Procurement: I need to loop in our Finance lead (I can add them next message) — we typically require a 60-day lead time for PO issuance.
- QBR window: both Blake and I prefer the week of Oct 18 (Wed/Thu best). We'll complete the poll but please tentatively block 10/20 11:00am PT for the exec readout.

Regarding usage signals — we'll pull a short export of our last 90 days (peak hour TPS and embeddings/sec) and drop into the mutual action plan doc by 9/10.

One ask: do you have a short summary of potential SLA uplift options and any one-time integration fees so I can prep Finance?

Amina Rahman

Team —

Great kickoff. A couple internal items I want on the tracker: 
- Staffing: assign one CS Lead and one Implementation Engineer to the onboarding runbook. I recommend assigning Priya for CS lead given her work with BlueShift earlier this year.
- Readiness call objective (9/13): confirm traffic model, KV/cache expectations, and cutover rollback plan.
- Deliverables: I will draft a 30/60/90 operations onboarding checklist for the call — aim to share before 9/12.

David, can you prepare two pricing sketches (staircase A: modest uplift with monthly smoothing; staircase B: faster uplift with startup discount) and include an estimated one-time integration cost for private VPC if customer requests? Please have a draft by 9/24 as Mateo outlined.

Karthik — once you size the config, let's also capture expected token-cost delta vs today (ballpark).

- Marissa
